The main takeaway from our work is that

phosphatization and (especially) silicification in Doushantou Formation sediments occurred at different depths within the water column and sediment column, but the differences in preservation and fossil composition are not great enough to preclude meaningful comparisons between phosphatized and chertified fossil assemblage data.

the Ediacaran fossil record is more complete than commonly appreciated, and that phosphatized and chertified microfossals are complementary and should be used in tandem to characterize the diversity and evolution of early life.
